title: What the Member Owed the Cooperative, Taken Off an Estate Settlement of Membership and Patronage Equity
content:
What is owed is taken off an estate settlement of Membership and Patronage Equity in the offset order the class fixes.

**First.** Where a feed programme stands active on the member's books and the invoices raised on it stand above the payments posted against it, the difference between them is taken off, rounded to two decimal places. The programme in question is one of the member's Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes, and what is compared is the invoices raised on it against the payments posted against it.

**Second.** Where no feed programme stands active and a crop input account stands with a balance still standing on it, the balance standing on that account is taken off. The account in question is one of the member's Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

**Third.** Where neither stands, nothing is taken off.

## The readings on hypothetical figures

| Feed programme standing active | Invoices raised on it | Payments posted against it | Crop input account balance | Taken off |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| yes | 9400.00 | 7250.00 | 1800.00 | 2150.00 |
| yes | 7250.00 | 7250.00 | 1800.00 | nothing |
| yes | 6100.00 | 7250.00 | 1800.00 | nothing |
| no | 9400.00 | 7250.00 | 1800.00 | 1800.00 |
| no | none | none | nothing standing | nothing |

**On the second and third lines.** The first reading requires the invoices to stand above the payments. Where they stand at or below them, the first reading does not hold; and because a feed programme still stands active, the second reading does not hold either, so nothing is taken off.

**On the fourth line.** With no feed programme standing active, it is the balance standing on the crop input account that is taken off, whatever the feed invoices show.
